title: From “Fail Fast” to “Mature Safely:” Expert Perspectives as Secondary Stakeholders on Teen-Centered Social Media Risk Detection
reasoning: The paper identifies 'ethical viability' as one of three primary dimensions for maturing teen-centered risk detection technology. It investigates specific ethical tensions such as data privacy for minors, the ethics of analyzing unconsenting third-party data, and the shift from 'policing' to 'advocacy' as part of a responsible innovation framework.
